name: GD Solver
description: GD Solver source port for Geometry Dash 2.2074. Unverified 2.2081 RNG writes disabled; in-game binary validation still required.

issues.info: Report problems on the GitHub issue tracker.

play-menu.name: Choose the mode on Play
play-menu.description: A level's play button opens a menu: Normal, Replay or Solve. Off, the play button just plays the level, as without the mod.
